icp.what_they_sell: Shape (shape-labs.com) is a Berlin/New York/Ljubljana AI-native process automation and venture studio. They rebuild business processes with custom AI-native software — including agentic workflows, RAG/LLM systems, process automation/RPA, data pipelines, analytics dashboards, internal AI tools, and marketing websites — to cut operating costs and eliminate busywork for digital businesses. They also build and operate their own AI SaaS products (ProductAI, Wondercut, MomentClip) and take on long-term client partnerships with equity arrangements. Minimum project size ~$25k; typical engagements run from MVP builds ($48k / 6 weeks) to multi-year transformation programmes.
icp.target_company_size: Seed-to-Series C startups and mid-market digital companies (20–500 employees) with live software products and manual or
buying_triggers: Raising a new funding round and needing to scale operations efficiently
Hiring in engineering/product — signal of active build-out
Publicly discussing AI automation or digital transformation on LinkedIn
Launching a new product line or marketplace expansion
Operating costly manual workflows (invoicing, reporting, content, customer ops)

prospects.title: Head of Operations
prospects.why_relevant: Runs operations at a 200-person DACH logistics firm that just announced an automation push — matches the mid-market, no-in-house-AI-team ICP, and ops is where Shape's automation pods land first.
signals: Company blog post announcing a 2026 automation initiative
Three open roles in process engineering

prospects.title: Co-Founder & CTO
prospects.why_relevant: CTO of a seed-funded Nordic B2B SaaS that publicly committed to AI features in its Q3 roadmap without any ML hires on the team page — the exact gap Shape's fixed-scope MVP builds fill.
prospects.source_note: funding announcement naming the founding team

prospects.title: VP of Product
prospects.why_relevant: Owns product at a mid-market e-commerce platform whose job posts mention 'AI-assisted merchandising' — an e-commerce AI use case Shape has shipped before with ProductAI.

prospects.title: Head of Innovation
prospects.why_relevant: Leads innovation at a DACH media group that spoke about AI content workflows at an industry conference — media/creative tooling is a listed target industry and a conference talk is a warm opener.
